name: Izumo 2 ~Gakuen Kyousoukyoku~
source:
After Izumo 2, Takeru and his friends come back to the present world. However, they don't have time to live a peaceful life due to Sakuya, who comes back again from Nenokuni. This time she is with a mysterious boy, Ninigi and he says that he is engaged to Sakuya. Sakuya doesn't want him and declares that Takeru is the one she loves. Also, Takeshi and Himiko appear...

[From Himeya Shop]
translation:
在出云2之后，猛和朋友们回到了现实世界。然而，由于咲耶从根之国再次归来，他们无暇享受平静的生活。这次，她身边多了一位神秘少年——琼琼杵，他声称自己与咲耶有婚约。咲耶并不接受他，宣布猛才是她心爱的人。此外，武和卑弥呼也登场了……

[改编自Himeya Shop]
